column1: # ATLAS3D early-type galaxies: the columns needed for a Faber-Jackson zero-point test.
# Assembled this session from three published sources:
#   Cappellari et al. 2013, MNRAS 432, 1709 (ATLAS3D XV; arXiv:1208.3522 table 1) -> logsig_e, logML_JAM,
#       logRe_maj, logRe, logr12 (all radii in arcsec), logL (L_sun,r), qual
#   Cappellari et al. 2013, MNRAS 432, 1862 (ATLAS3D XX; arXiv:1208.3523 table 1) -> fDM(Re), logML_stars,
#       logML_Salp  (r-band stellar-population M/L for a Salpeter IMF -- the INDEPENDENT stellar mass)
#   VizieR J/MNRAS/413/813/atlas3d (ATLAS3D I) -> Dist (Mpc), KMAG, Virgo flag, T-type
